source_documents.title: Electronic and Geometric Characterization of TICT Formation in Hemithioindigo Photoswitches by Picosecond Infrared Spectroscopy

reference_evidence_units.quote: Z-1 and Z-2 show no spectral evolution of the initial excited-state spectrum toward new excited-state species in the apolar solvent dCH.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Z-1
reference_evidence_units.statement: No TICT species in apolar solvent.

reference_evidence_units.quote: 210 ps for Z-1 and 32 ps for Z-2 in dDCM.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Z-1
reference_evidence_units.statement: TICT state decays in 210 ps (17.8 ps in DMSO).

reference_evidence_units.quote: For Z-1, in dDCM (see Figure 3a,c), the C−O band shows a qualitatively similar behavior
reference_evidence_units.subject: Z-1
reference_evidence_units.statement: C=O marker band shifts as in Z-2: charge flows into the HTI fragment.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Here, we present a combined experimental and theoretical study of the twisted intramolecular charge transfer (TICT) process in hemithioindigo photoswitches.
reference_evidence_units.subject: HTI series
reference_evidence_units.statement: TICT formation characterised by transient IR.
